children: Insight Molecular Diagnostics entered into Amendment No. 2 to its Merger Agreement with the equityholder representative of Chronix on Sep 15 2026. The amendment provides Chronix equity holders a 10% royalty on CNI Monitor sales until the earlier of a sale of CNI Monitor or expiration of related IP. If a sale occurs, they will receive a final payment equal to 10% of the gross sale proceeds, and the ongoing royalty will end. The changes streamline economics and provide flexibility for a potential asset sale.
